title: Detached Ed25519 signature
description: A signature is over the CANONICAL form (mkt.canon: sorted keys, no whitespace, floats forbidden) of the signed document with its own `signature` key removed, prefixed by a domain-separation tag. The tag is mandatory and part of the signed bytes: without it an index signature could be replayed as a manifest signature over the same byte string.

domain.description: Domain-separation tag. Closed set -- an unrecognised domain must fail verification rather than be treated as generic.

signed_digest.description: sha256 of the exact bytes that were signed. Recorded so a verification failure can be attributed: digest mismatch means the document changed, digest match with signature mismatch means the key or the signature is wrong. Without it every failure looks the same.
